item.title: Htmx 4.0
item.description: Release announcement, 2026-08-28. (3 sources: hackernews, lobsters, rprogramming)

item.title: SpaceXAI Grok 4.6 now available on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US)
item.description: Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US) now supports SpaceXAI Grok 4.6, a frontier model built for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory now supports fine-grained access control
item.description: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory now supports fine-grained access control (FGAC), enabling you to enforce per-user and per-tenant memory isolation through AgentCore Gateway without building custom authorization logic. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory now supports flexible namespace variables
item.description: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory now lets developers define flexible namespace variables to scope long-term memories along any application-specific dimension - such as organization, tenant, team, or environment - without creating duplicate… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore expands to two new regions
item.description: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is now available in two additional AWS Regions: US West (N. California) and Asia Pacific (Hyderabad). Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is the platform to build, connect, and optimize agents. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 C8gn instances are now available in AWS Europe (Paris) region
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) C8gn instances, powered by the latest-generation AWS Graviton4 processors, are available in the AWS Europe (Paris) region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Transform now in scope for FedRAMP Class C
item.description: AWS Transform is now in scope for FedRAMP Class C (formerly Moderate baseline) in the US East (Ohio) Region. You can now use AWS Transform to build applications and run workloads that are subject to FedRAMP Class C compliance requirements. (1 source: aws)
